working_target.geometric: For noncoplanar ordered x_1,...,x_4 in R^3, justify the inverse-tetrahedron-volume factor when a measure on sphere centres, radii and four surface points is pushed to Cartesian point coordinates.
working_target.process: Distinguish that identity from existence of a stationary simple locally finite process with all three exact full reciprocal-simplex factorial densities on E_n(M).
working_target.notation: V=abs(det[x_2-x_1,x_3-x_1,x_4-x_1])/6; q=R^2; g4, if normalised, is rho4/lambda^4; measures are ordered and surface measure is unnormalised area.

sources.author: Aurelie Chapron
sources.title: A local Blaschke-Petkantschin formula in a Riemannian manifold
sources.locator: printed p. 1 (zero-based PDF page 0), Introduction, equation (1); references printed p.19 (PDF page18)
sources.assertion_status: equality of measures for Euclidean spherical coordinates, explicitly stated; attributed there to Miles1970 formula70
sources.formula: dx_1...dx_(n+1)=n! Delta_n(u_1,...,u_(n+1)) R^(n^2-1) dR dz product_i domega(u_i)
sources.definitions: x_i=z+R u_i, R>0, u_i on unit S^(n-1); Delta_n is ordinary simplex volume; domega is surface area, not probability measure. Unique circumsphere for almost every Euclidean tuple.
sources.geometry_outcome: A for explicitly stated forward identity; C for the inverse-volume density after the derivation below
sources.full_process_outcome: D: the geometric identity does not itself construct the requested point process or establish its other factorial densities
sources.proof_inspection: Inspected complete relevant statement, definitions and attribution. Did not independently audit the full Riemannian theorem or directly inspect Miles1970.

sources.title: Random Inscribed Polytopes Have Similar Radius Functions as Poisson-Delaunay Mosaics
sources.mismatch: The domain is tuples on a fixed ambient unit sphere S^n, with subsphere decomposition and a simplex-volume power. Related spherical integral geometry; not the direct Euclidean ambient R^3 identity needed here.
sources.proof_inspection: Inspected theorem, adjacent measure conventions and applicability; not a complete proof audit.

derivation: Specialise Chapron equation(1) to n=3: dx^4 = 6 Delta_3(u) R^8 dz dR domega^4.
Since V(x)=R^3 Delta_3(u), this is dx^4=6 V(x) R^5 dz dR domega^4.
A sphere-family first intensity gamma(R) dz dR and Poisson surface intensity t(R) sigma_(z,R) give same-sphere ordered fourth measure with parameter weight gamma(R) t(R)^4 R^8 dz dR domega^4.
Dividing by the Cartesian Jacobian gives rho4_same(x)=gamma(R*) t(R*)^4 R*^3/[6 V(x)], evaluated at the unique circumradius R*.
In winning v04, t(R)=a(R)/(2R) and gamma(R)a(R)^4/(2R)=c; hence rho4_same=c/(48 V).
Equivalently, F_i(z,q)=|x_i-z|^2-q has four by four Jacobian determinant of absolute value 8|det[x2-x1,x3-x1,x4-x1]|=48V, by subtracting the first row from the other three.
Surface separation makes same-sphere equal to full rho4 on diameter<M. This equality needs the construction, not only the published coordinate formula.
Normalising by a constant intensity to obtain g4 changes only the multiplicative constant.
provenance: The frozen common construction seed, coordinator_submission_v02 section5, already contains an affine Gaussian shot-noise calculation with determinant6V giving c4=pi^2/(6V), explicitly a fourth factorial cumulant, not the full fourth density.
proof_4 v01 explicitly acknowledges that shared determinant-integration lead and rederives the determinant.
proof_1 v04 and proof_4 v04 both give explicit spherical coarea calculations. The packet protocol permitted common starting material but prohibited transfer of new construction ideas between tracks.
The winning v04 proof provides the calculation internally and makes no literature novelty/priority claim. A derivation in the run is not evidence that the identity is new.
overall_outcome: C for the sphere-based inverse-volume identity from a verified published formula, with the short derivation supplied; D for what those geometric sources establish about the full process. No publication of the exact full winning process was located within this small search; this is not a novelty claim.
limitations: Historical Miles1970 attribution was verified in Chapron, not in the original1970 article.
No exhaustive literature search, novelty statement or fresh audit of the accepted existence proof.
